== Notes ==
* This boss shares spawning points in the mission [[Bloodstone Fen]] with [[Torr the Relentless]], [[Ramm the Benevolent]], [[Oswald the Amiable]] and [[Pleoh the Ugly]]. As such, there is a chance that Nyle will not spawn at all.
* [[Guilt]] is a skill that may be beneficial to [[Signet of Capture|capture]] from Nyle in this mission, since the earliest time to acquire it will be as a quest reward of [[The Misplaced Sword]] later in [[Heroes' Audience]] within the [[Crystal Desert]].
